'''Andrea''' (Japanese: '''アヤノ''' ''Ayano'') is a [[character of the day]] who lives in [[Megi City]] on [[Yellow Rock Isle]] with her little sister [[Mika]] and their {{TP|Mika and Andrea|father}}. The whole family appeared in ''[[EP213|A Corsola Caper!]]''.

Andrea helps out her father in the family business of collecting {{p|Corsola}} horns to make jewelry. One day, when an [[Misty's Corsola|over-excited Corsola]] stumbled across the family, it inadvertently scared off the other Corsola. As a result, the family's home, which rested on top of a Corsola colony, floated away with Mika.

With the help of {{Ash}} and his friends, Mika was saved. After relaying their story, Ash decided to help find the missing Corsola. With his help, all the Corsola were safely found. The Corsola who scared off the others was {{pkmn2|caught}} by {{an|Misty}}.

She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[EP226|Espeon, Not Included]]''.
